## Change

Describe the problem, affected pack IDs and versions, and expected behavior.
Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

- [ ] Repository validator and unit tests pass.
- [ ] Manifests and artifacts agree; generated indexes/catalog are current.
- [ ] Changed published packs have new versions, or an owner-approved pre-release reset is explained.
- [ ] Rules and JSONL corpus validated with current Kosha (include version and commands).
- [ ] Changed phrases checked with synthetic matches and non-matches on affected OSes.
- [ ] Rights, attribution, and MIT OR Apache-2.0 licensing checked.
- [ ] Every commit has DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`); no co-author trailers.

Include results here. Do not attach private file inventories or credentials.
